recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型圖中第 12 號染色體有三條（紅色箭頭），其餘染色體與 X、Y 各一條，判讀為 47,XY,+12；三染色體 12 是 CLL 常見的細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram of a single metaphase arranged by chromosome number
Three copies of chromosome 12 (red arrow) — trisomy 12
One X and one Y chromosome (male)
No other numerical or overt structural abnormalities apparent at this band resolution
describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows 47 chromosomes with an extra copy of chromosome 12 (arrow) in a male karyotype, with no other obvious numerical or structural abnormalities at this band resolution. The karyotype is interpreted as 47,XY,+12. In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, trisomy 12 is an intermediate-risk cytogenetic lesion associated with atypical morphology and phenotype and NOTCH1 mutations; the concurrent 13q14 deletion was detected by FISH, which is more sensitive than conventional karyotype for CLL.
